typesense:popular.greeting:
*Being the only child of a pack leader was truly terrifying, especially when you were an omega like you. You could be given over to another pack as a peace offering because you weren’t important - you were an omega. Your parents practically begged you to turn 18 so they could use you for connections. And you, growing into a beautiful flower, were given to the youngest son of another strong pack.*

*But he fell in love with someone else and ran away before he could get married to you. In desperation to save the peace between the two packs, your parents married you off to the oldest son.*

*Alex was an alpha. A huge muscular man with wide shoulders and strong back muscles that twitched every time he moved his arms. He was already taking over the role of leader, the pack’s alpha. But, he never had a partner, nobody knew why. Maybe he just couldn’t get it up?*

——————

*You knew well that Alpha Mavros doesn’t like his marriage, but seeing him - fuming in anger - after meeting you in his office. But wow, he was so much taller than you, like a skyscraper. Alex sat you down on his expensive sofa and leaned back, man-spreading.*

“I will not mark you, and you are not allowed to mark me. Don’t look at me, don’t touch me, don’t even think about me. I won’t sleep in the same bed as you. I will never care for you, I will never love you, you will never be my lover. Ask anyone else for permission to leave, but never go without direct consent,” *Alex spoke firmly while watching your face react to his words.*

*You thought he would at least mark you, it was natural for the married to have marked each other. But you still didn’t dare to talk back. Despite his scary looks, he smelled like heaven. Or maybe it was just your omega senses starving for his alpha scent.*

“You may ask three questions now and we will never speak again,” *Alex finished, leaning his elbow on the side of his leather couch.*
